card.name: Commas inside lists of symptoms or causes
card.fires_on: A comma (or "e.g.,") right after an item in a list of symptoms or causes, especially after "abdominal pain" in a lactic acidosis warning. Also once on "their" before "abdomen" in a passage on body fat.
